limitations: This slice prioritizes explicitly released property cohorts and generation benchmarks; broad parent databases are handled in other research slices.
No summation across materials, structure entries, task samples, source papers, generated candidates or displaced configurations is valid.

Some publisher/portal pages returned HTTP 403 or captcha; primary-paper text was retrieved as Europe PMC fullTextXML where available. Successful source responses and SHA-256 hashes are retained under research/evidence-benchmarks/.
Dataset license is marked Not verified unless specific data terms were read; software licensing is not substituted for dataset licensing.

Downloads of complete multi-terabyte and other large datasets were not performed. Most counts are author-reported release sizes; the PhononDB LTC count was independently derived from the author index.
Full AFLOW AEL/AGL cohort size, raw LeMat-Synth access, and OpenLAM Crystal Philately bulk download remain unverified.
No biological macromolecule/PDB or isolated-molecule corpus is included.

Source verification was primary-provider or primary-author based. Several pages were fetched through official REST APIs when rendered pages hid licensing; hashes are retained under evidence-specialized.
Explicit data licenses remain unverified for some 2DHub projects, legacy hMOF/PCOD/IZA, X23/ICE13, BEAST and the SAC portal. A paper or software license was not silently applied to raw data.
The documented numeric count is deliberately a dated release/subset when live counts are unavailable. OC20/OC22/OC25/ODAC/OMC/Zeo-1 count frames, IZA counts topology types.
JARVIS 2D archive independently contains 1,103 records despite documentation 1,109. Public OMC25 train+val totals 26,257,042 frames despite full-paper27M+ description.
DigCat current provider count differs from the requested ACS Perspective >500k computational claim; no unique-material count or exact release behind that claim was independently verified.
Broader 2D materials such as Alexandria2D belong to the root inorganic-family audit; NOMAD and Materials Cloud are aggregators recorded separately by the root.
Additional recent resources worth future verification include LitMOF-DB, OC20NEB/AQCat25, zeolite adsorption configurations, MOF stability datasets and private molecular-crystal prediction corpora.
